summary: Pre-EAS check of build-v70.13-ptt-scrollview-fix. All 4 v70.13 fixes are applied correctly, and the git diff a62f48e3..HEAD contains ONLY these changes plus the build tag, so there are no other regressions. (1) The pager ScrollView (index.tsx:6900-6901) has canCancelContentTouches={false} and delaysContentTouches={false}. (2) paywall.tsx:40 and (3) quotaExhaustedAudio.ts:24 import getIntroAsset, and introAssetProvider.ts:79 exports it. (4) eas.json preview and production both have EXPO_PUBLIC_USE_CLIENT_STT='true' and EXPO_PUBLIC_USE_WS_VOICE_STREAM='true'. Build tag = build-v70.13-ptt-scrollview-fix. stopTalk is a NO-OP in WS mode: recRef.current is only set in the legacy path (line 3932); native goes to startTalkStreaming at line 3884; stopTalk has no stream.stop or streamingSessionRef. Metro production bundles compile for iOS (200, 10.4MB) and Android (200, 10.4MB). Both contain the v70.13 tag, canCancelContentTouches:false, and the imported getIntroAsset calls. tsc: no 'Cannot find name' or missing-import errors in index.tsx, paywall.tsx or quotaExhaustedAudio.ts. Backend on preview AND Railway prod: /api/health 200; /api/transcribe-inworld returns 422 with no body, 400 for an empty file, and 200 with Italian text; WS /api/voice/stream with stt_source=client_apple returns ready. STILL FAILING: WS stt_source=deepgram returns 'STT unavailable: HTTP 401', because the Deepgram key is invalid on preview and prod (same as iteration 29). Web login screen renders with no page errors. RISK, NOT A CRASH: on iOS, canCancelContentTouches=false together with RN's built-in delaysContentTouches=NO means UIScrollView will not start a horizontal drag once a touch lands on a child view. Swiping voice<->reading ('scorri per scrivere') may stop working on iOS. This cannot be verified on web and needs an on-device check.

critical.issue: The Deepgram key is rejected with 401 on preview AND Railway prod (startup warmup status 401; WS returns {type:error,'STT unavailable: server rejected WebSocket connection: HTTP 401'}). The iOS client_apple path is not affected. Android, and any iOS device where on-device STT is unsupported, fall back to Deepgram, so every voice turn there will fail. Unchanged since iteration 29.

integration_issues.issue: canCancelContentTouches={false} is applied permanently (index.tsx:6900). RN iOS already forces delaysContentTouches=NO (RCTScrollViewComponentView.mm:132). With both NO, UIKit does not let the scroll view pan once a subview starts tracking the touch. Swipes that start on page content (orb, text, timeline) will probably not change page on iOS. Android ignores the prop. This needs an on-device check before or right after the build. Safer alternative: toggle it only while the PTT hold is active, e.g. state pttHolding set in onBigButtonPressIn/Out and then canCancelContentTouches={!pttHolding} or scrollEnabled={!pttHolding}.

react_native_issues.issue: delaysContentTouches is not a React Native ScrollView prop (tsc TS2769). It is silently ignored, which is harmless because RN already sets it to NO natively. The fix effectively relies on canCancelContentTouches alone. Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:6901

action_items: Verify on the iOS device that swiping voice<->reading still works. If it is broken, make canCancelContentTouches (or scrollEnabled) conditional on an active PTT hold instead of always false.
Rotate or fix DEEPGRAM_API_KEY on the Railway prod and preview backends (401 INVALID_AUTH). This breaks voice on Android and in the iOS fallback.

Optional: remove the ineffective delaysContentTouches prop (index.tsx:6901), and update the stale comment in onBigButtonPressOut (index.tsx:4490), which still says stopTalk handles streamingSessionRef.

Optional: the preview-android profile overrides env with only BACKEND_URL; add the two EXPO_PUBLIC_USE_* flags there too if that profile is used. The production profile uses channel 'preview' (pre-existing).
